architecture: One shared 48/24 tanh network with three jointly trained outputs. The entry value is forecast net basis points. TP and SL are separate bounded log-distance heads, continuous over 50–500 and 25–350 bps. The position retains its predicted pair. No holding deadline.
inputs: Decision-time market state, trade direction, SMA setup age, and four publication-age flags. The one network architecture includes archived News Intelligence inputs whenever their actual recorded coverage is available. Earlier base fit has those columns zeroed. Recent fine-tuning starts from the base network and updates all weights and heads jointly.
training: Causal counterfactual reward matrix from the prior desk-risk-sized 25-bracket grid, fees, slippage and settled funding, averaged across base and stress. Unfilled orders earn zero. Positions still open at the model's historical cutoff contribute marked equity. A differentiable Gaussian weighting over log-distance knots smooths the measured payoff surface during training. Gradients from net dollar return flow through both distances and a soft 15-bps entry gate. A Huber auxiliary loss calibrates raw expected basis points. Calendar days and setups have equal weight. The exact continuous output is used in every forward replay rather than the approximating grid.
chronology: Expand from November 13 2025. Use four May-to-August calibration blocks and a final fit strictly before Aug 22. Fit the News Intelligence continuation on recorded November 1–13 outcomes, with three expanding calibration blocks and test from Nov 14. All reward and calibration labels use prices and funding through the respective fold end only; mark remaining positions. Adam 12 epochs, seed 92, 1024 maximum batch, .002 base learning rate and .0006 during news fine-tuning.
evaluation: Use existing August–November and short November windows. Apply exact continuous bracket hits with the frozen exposure and risk constraints of desk mandate v17 and original candle proxy, and the same 15 bps entry hurdle. Reuse chronological direction-specific median calibration including disabled sides for flat calibration slope. Show the full joint policy, the same jointly learned exits with a constant entry score, prior fixed-bracket control, and cash. Previously studied historical periods.
